title: IWARP_DDP_RDMAP: fix Terminate tree hierarchy and layer name mappings
description:
Fix Terminate layer name mapping.

Fix Terminate opcode tree hierarchy, the Terminate Control
tree should be under the Terminate tree.

Change Terminate header bits to set-notset.

Fix error codes for RDMA layer, display the error code name
only if it is not an RDMA Local Catastrophic error type.

Add MPA error codes given by RFC5044, add error type name
mapping for the LLP (Lower Layer Protocol). Add error code
name mapping for the MPA Error type.

Add MPA error codes given by RFC6581

    iWARP Direct Data Placement and Remote Direct Memory Access Protocol
        DDP header
            ...
        RDMAP header
            ...
    <<< current:
            Terminate
                ...0 0011 0000 0000 = Reserved: 0x0300
            Terminate Control
                0010 .... = Layer: Unknown (0x2)
                .... 0000 = Error Types for LLP layer: 0x0
                Error Code for LLP layer: 0x07
                Header control bits
                    0... .... = M bit: 0x0
                    .0.. .... = D bit: 0x0
                    ..0. .... = R bit: 0x0
    >>> fixed:
            Terminate
                Terminate Control
                    0010 .... = Layer: LLP (0x2)
                    .... 0000 = Error Types for LLP layer: MPA Error (0x0)
                    Error Code for LLP layer: No Matching RTR Option (0x07)
                    Header control bits
                        0... .... = M bit: Not set
                        .0.. .... = D bit: Not set
                        ..0. .... = R bit: Not set
                ...0 0011 0000 0000 = Reserved: 0x0300
